summaries: A Form 10-K Annual Report for Arvana Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2018. Relevant to the task: This filing predates the requested 2019–2024 period but provides the immediate year-end 2018 baseline. It reports 1,034,030 common shares outstanding at December 31, 2018, with 5,000,000 authorized shares at $0.001 par value, unchanged from 2017. The document contains no share capital data for 2019 through 2024, so it cannot address the trend directly, though it establishes the starting point prior to the requested range.

A Form 10-K annual report for Arvana Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2019. Relevant to the task: This document establishes the share capital baseline at the end of the first year in the requested timeframe, confirming 1,034,030 common shares outstanding as of December 31, 2019. It explicitly states that no shares were issued during the 2019 fiscal year, maintaining the same balance as the previous year. While it provides the critical 2019 data point needed to measure the start of the trend, the report does not contain financial statements or share counts for the years 2020 through 2024.

A Form 10-K annual report for Arvana Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2020. Relevant to the task: It establishes the company's share capital figures for the transition from 2019 to 2020, recording 1,034,030 shares outstanding at the end of 2019 and 4,610,670 at the end of 2020. The Statement of Stockholders' Deficiency and Note 3 detail a 2020 issuance of 3,576,640 restricted shares used to extinguish debt and pay for services, marking the first significant increase in the requested trend. The document notes the authorized capital remained at 5,000,000 shares during the fiscal year, with a subsequent increase to 500,000,000 shares disclosed in the Subsequent Events section. While essential for verifying the 2019-2020 period, the report does not extend to the years 2021 through 2024.

A Form 10-K annual report for Arvana Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2021. Relevant to the task: It provides audited share capital data for the 2019 through 2021 period, bridging the gap between the 2020 and 2022 filings. The Statement of Stockholders’ Deficiency confirms outstanding shares increased from 4,610,670 at year-end 2020 to 34,148,518 at year-end 2021, continuing the upward trend from the 1,034,030 shares reported at year-end 2019. This 2021 increase was driven by issuing 29,537,848 shares to settle debts and liabilities, compared to 3,576,640 shares issued in 2020. The document details the specific issuances and resulting share counts for 2021 but contains no financial data for the years 2022 through 2024.

A Form 10-K annual report for Arvana Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. Relevant to the task: The document reports 35,948,518 common shares outstanding at December 31, 2022, an increase of 1,800,000 shares from the 34,148,518 recorded at December 31, 2021. Note 4 specifies this change resulted from 1,600,000 shares issued in a private placement and 200,000 shares issued to settle related party debt. Note 10 discloses a 3-for-1 forward stock split approved in February 2023, indicating the 2022 year-end share count is pre-split and requires adjustment to align with post-split figures in subsequent years. The filing provides the necessary 2022 data point but does not contain share capital data for 2023 or 2024.

A Form 10-K annual report for Arvana Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Relevant to the task: The document records outstanding common shares at 107,845,554 at year-end 2022 and 2023, confirming no new stock issuance occurred during the 2023 fiscal year (Note 7). It documents the implementation of a 3-for-1 forward stock split effective April 19, 2023, which was applied retroactively to prior period capital structure figures. The report also discloses a share count of 107,845,554 as of April 5, 2024. While this establishes a period of stability in share capital following the significant increases in prior years, it lacks data for the full 2024 calendar year, meaning it contributes the 2023 endpoint to the trend analysis but cannot independently confirm the status for the remainder of the 2019-to-2024 period.
